title: Send an attachment
caption: Attachment caption (optional)
help: Images: JPEG/PNG, up to 5 MiB. Documents: PDF, text or Office files, up to 16 MiB. Workspace limits may be lower.
confirm: Send this attachment to the customer?
queued: Attachment queued. Delivery status appears in the conversation.
uncertain: Delivery could not be confirmed. Check the conversation before sending another copy.
error: Could not queue the attachment. Try again.
size: The selected file exceeds the attachment size limit.
noTranscript: No automatic interpretation is available. An agent can review the original attachment.
tooLong: Voice notes over five minutes are sent to an agent without transcription.
